need.purpose_or_required_outcome: Research an open evidence question where the next search/tool action must change based on intermediate evidence conflicts and gaps.

responsibilities: choose the next tool/query based on observed gap
stop when evidence criteria are satisfied

solution.mechanism_or_implementation_candidate: replaceable agent runtime with bounded tools and stop criteria
solution.short_rationale: The next action cannot be fixed in advance because it materially depends on intermediate observations.

evidence_requirements: same task cannot be represented as a known fixed path without losing required adaptivity

governance.stop_condition: Stop at one bounded Agent when adaptive control is proven; do not add subagents without separate need.
